subject.title: Automatic git worktree management for agent tasks

question: Should managed git worktrees be accepted as a core OpenClaw service through the linked PR, narrowed to a smaller Workboard/gateway seam, or deferred outside core for now?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested solution adds a new core lifecycle and executable repo hook semantics that automation should not accept without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Review Linked Core PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and review its storage, security, protocol, CLI, UI, and Workboard design before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow The Scope
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller first slice that only materializes Workboard `worktree` cards through a minimal core seam.

options.title: Defer Outside Core
options.body: Reject or defer the core service if maintainers decide existing plugin/workspace/sandbox surfaces should own this capability instead.

recommendation.title: Review Linked Core PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and review its storage, security, protocol, CLI, UI, and Workboard design before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete authored the issue and linked PR and is the strongest history match for the current Workboard workspace metadata.
